subject: Your GitHub Copilot trial ends in 7 days

messages.subject: Your GitHub Copilot trial ends in 7 days

messages.body:
Dear Arjein,

Your trial is ending soon. At the end of the trial, your GitHub Copilot subscription will continue at $10/month billed to your credit card.

You can cancel your Copilot Pro subscription trial at any time before April 27 and you won't be charged.

If you do not cancel the trial before the end, the trial will automatically convert to a paid subscription starting from April 27.

Read the billing documentation for more details.

Manage subscription: https://github.com/settings/billing/summary

You can manage your billing preferences or you can cancel your Copilot Pro subscription at any time: https://docs.github.com/billing/managing-billing-for-github-copilot/managing-your-github-copilot-subscription-for-your-personal-account
Read billing documentation for more details. https://docs.github.com/billing/managing-billing-for-github-copilot/about-billing-for-github-copilot

Having trouble getting started with GitHub Copilot? Visit our Getting Started Page: https://github.com/features/copilot/tutorials
